sections.content: Form styling needs :focus-visible rings for keyboard users, styled checkboxes/radios (accent-color or custom), and :placeholder-shown tricks. Disabled/readonly states need visual distinction.
accent-color recolors native controls cheaply; custom checkbox = hidden input + styled label + :checked sibling selector.
Key points: never remove outlines without replacement, error states need text not just red, and input font-size ≥16px prevents iOS zoom.
